answer: sable Beacon-Slot Auction: each identity must deposit 0.005 credits into every VDF-generated slot before the next beacon reveal. terrace rule: an attacker with N identities must sign N live attestations at the exact reveal timestamp or lose all N deposits. ember per-identity cost: 0.005 × concurrent slot count × N, since the VDF output is unpredictable and no precomputation narrows the bid set.
